newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK JULY PRIVATE CONSTRUCTION UP 42.5PCT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK JULY PRIVATE CONSTRUCTION UP 42.5PCT.

text.p: Greece's index of private construction activity measured by the number of building permits issued jumped 42.5 percent year-on-year in July, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said in a statement.
"In July construction volume based on the number of building permits nationwide reached 8.54 million cubic metres against 5.99 million in July 1995, a rise of 42.5 percent," NSS said.
July construction activity in the Attica region was up 77.1 percent year-on-year reaching 3.36 million cubic metres.
Construction activity had jumped 8.4 percent year-on-year in June.
In the first six months of the year, private construction activity was up 25.4 percent with the rise more pronounced in the Attica region, up 43.4 percent.
